correctness.rationale: Published Type-A lemma yields uniquely an even alternating interval for adjacent equal-weight words. Position-sum change is ±t with 1≤t≤min(k,n-k), so the indicated modulus separates every edge. Explicit r+1 pairwise alternating-core words form a matching clique. Five checked 8-bit words induce C5, with common-prefix/suffix padding preserving difference intervals. Two independent finite checkers complete through n=10 and 14 (and C5 padding through n=16); infinity is proved by the interval argument, not by these computations.
